title: Row F, Seat Eleven
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：seat　|　正文 304 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 seat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven years my ① seat at the concert hall was the same one — row F, ② seat eleven — and the ③ seat of it, worn smooth by forty years of somebody else, was the most comfortable thing I have ever sat on. I had not chosen it: it was given to me in 1998 by a woman in the box office who said it was the best seat in the house for hearing a quartet, and who was right.

Every Thursday I ④ took the same seat, and the woman who checked tickets stopped looking at mine in 1998. My father had a ⑤ seat on the council for eleven years and hated every minute of it: he said a seat on a committee is not a seat at all, because you cannot hear anything from it, and because the people who give you one can take it back.
Once the conductor asked whether everybody was ⑥ seated before he began, and I was the only person in the hall who answered him. He looked at me for what felt like eleven seconds, and then he began.

The town is the ⑦ seat of the county's music, which sounds like praise and is not, since it only means the money comes from somewhere else. Eleven miles away stands a ⑧ country seat, empty since 1974, with eleven bedrooms and one piano that nobody has been able to move, and which my father called the saddest object in the county.

In 2015 the hall was refurbished and row F was rebuilt; every ⑨ seat was replaced, and the new ones are better in every way except one. I have not been back. On the way home that last Thursday I did up my ⑩ seat belt at the same junction, and thought about how little of any of it I had chosen.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （议会、委员会的）席位
C. n. 所在地；中心（the seat of ...）
D. n. （椅子、裤子的）座面；臀部
E. 固定搭配：take a seat 就座；坐下
F. 固定搭配：be seated 就座；坐好
G. 固定搭配：seat belt 安全带
H. n. 宅邸；乡间别墅（a country seat）

items.q: my seat at the concert hall
the seat of it, worn smooth
My father had a seat on the council
The town is the seat of the county's music
I did up my seat belt

answers.why: seat 意为“座位”，我在音乐厅的座位十一年都是同一个。
seat eleven 意为“十一号座位”，指排与号。
the seat of ... 意为“座面、椅面”，被别人坐了四十年，磨得发亮。
take a seat 意为“就座、坐下”，我每周四都坐同一个座位。
a seat on ... 意为“……里的席位”，我父亲在议会有一个席位，当了十一年。
be seated 意为“就座、坐好”，指挥问大家是否都已经坐好。
the seat of ... 意为“……的所在地／中心”，这座小城是本县音乐的中心。
a country seat 意为“乡间宅邸、别墅”，十一英里外那座宅子自 1974 年起就空着。
every seat 意为“每一个座位”，2015 年翻修时 F 排所有座位都换掉了。
seat belt 意为“安全带”，回家路上我在同一个路口系上了安全带。
